propositions: Provider-prefixed model_ref strings (e.g. anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6, openai:gpt-5.4) passed to genai_prices.calc_price raise LookupError and silently drop usage rows from cost totals
Bare model_ref strings without provider prefix (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6, gpt-5.4) resolve correctly in genai_prices and price as expected
Bedrock-prefixed model_ref forms resolve while Anthropic and OpenAI prefixed forms do not, creating asymmetric cost comparison bias in provider analysis
usage_log._price_row catches LookupError and marks rows unpriced without warning, making the failure invisible in output and indistinguishable from genuinely unknown models
ID translation must use registry membership rather than prefix matching or string splitting to correctly handle all provider formats including versioned AWS IDs
